ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这一研究推翻了流行的观点,即人类在30万年前进化时,所有人类的语音都存在。 “我们使用的一套语音自人类出现以来并不一定保持稳定,而我们今天发现的各种各样的语音是生物变化和文化进化等事物复杂相互作用的产物。

ex.s: Nature seems to unfold to people who watch and wait． Next time you take a walk， no matter where it is， take in all the sights， sounds and sensations． Wander in this frame of mind and you will open a new dimension to your life．
